reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in the DM. I haven't set up a 09:00 schedule. My scheduled jobs run in a separate session and their output is saved locally, not delivered to this DM, so I told him I can post a digest on request instead. I posted that reply before checking the scheduler options, so the reasoning is my inference from the scheduler's documented behaviour, not something I tested.

If Kwame wants a true daily push, it needs a messaging platform connected to the scheduler, which this workspace doesn't have. Whether to set that up is for your admin to decide. Until then, he can ask for a digest whenever he wants one, and I'll read #coastal-team (he's a member) and post what's new.
